Indian Badminton Players Shine at Hong Kong Open

Indian badminton players achieved significant victories at the Hong Kong Open. Rakshitha Sree delivered a career-best performance by defeating Olympic champion Chen Yu Fei. In doubles, the pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the quarterfinals. Lakshya Sen also continued his strong performance, outwitting Denmark's Rasmus Gemke and securing his place in the BWF World Tour Finals.
